scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.prod:stop: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.playoff-picks.plist && lsof -ti:5174 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.prod:restart: npm run prod:stop && npm run prod:start
scripts.prod:deploy: npm run build && npm run prod:restart
scripts.db:backup: mkdir -p backups && cp server/data.db backups/data-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).db && echo 'Backup created in backups/'
